candidates.snippet: Central Park’s horse-drawn carriage drivers have sued New York City to stop a new law that will ban the iconic tourist attraction, challenging Mayor Zohran Mamdani just minutes after he signed a bill to wind down the industry. https://t.co/HGRiQVoTBt
